description: | Lecture 10 - Text to Speech.pdf | | Lecture 10 - Text to Speech.pdf |  |  |. | Lecture 12- Memory Lecture.pdf | | Lecture 12- Memory Lecture.pdf |  |  |. | Lecture 1b - Deep Neural Networks Are Our Friends.pdf | | Lecture 1b - Deep Neural Networks Are Our Friends.pdf |  |  |. | Lecture 2b - Overview of the Practicals.pdf | | Lecture 2b - Overview of the Practicals.pdf |  |  |. This repository contains the lecture slides and course description for the Deep Natural Language Processing course offered in Hilary Term 2017 at the University of Oxford. These topics are organised into three high level themes forming a progression from understanding the use of neural networks for sequential language modelling, to understanding their use as conditional language models for transduction tasks, and finally to approaches employing these techniques in combination with other mechanisms for advanced applications.
